keyEvents.text: First Half begins.

Goal! RB Leipzig 1, Eintracht Frankfurt 0. Ezechiel Banzuzi (RB Leipzig) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Neil El Aynaoui with a cross following a fast break.
Goal! RB Leipzig 2, Eintracht Frankfurt 0. Christopher Nkunku (RB Leipzig) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Antonio Nusa.
Neil El Aynaoui (RB Leipzig) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! RB Leipzig 3, Eintracht Frankfurt 0. Christopher Nkunku (RB Leipzig) left footed shot from very close range to the high centre of the goal.
Goal! RB Leipzig 4, Eintracht Frankfurt 0. Christopher Nkunku (RB Leipzig) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the high centre of the goal.
First Half ends, RB Leipzig 4, Eintracht Frankfurt 0.
Substitution, Eintracht Frankfurt. Elias Baum replaces Robin Koch.
Substitution, Eintracht Frankfurt. Younes Ebnoutalib replaces Keita Kosugi.
Second Half begins RB Leipzig 4, Eintracht Frankfurt 0.
Goal! RB Leipzig 5, Eintracht Frankfurt 0. Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) right footed shot from the left side of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Ezechiel Banzuzi.
